name: Plan budget burn
summary: Plans and tracks budget burn for a health-care business: reads the budgets and the budget summary report from Xero every day and stores them for the owner's burn read. Nothing is changed, sent or approved by a cron.

covered_by.compare-to-budget: skill (agent reads the stored burn read)
covered_by.flag-overspend: skill (agent reads the stored burn read)
covered_by.approve-spend: not covered: Xero docs describe no budget check at approval
covered_by.report-to-owner: skill (owner read, sent by a person)
covered_by.adjust-budget: not covered: Xero API budget operations are read only

crons.name: budget-read
crons.summary: Copy the Xero budgets (planned amounts per account and period) into the store.

crons.name: burn-check
crons.summary: Read the Xero budget summary report and store it under today's date for the burn read. 19:00 UTC is 5 or 6 am in eastern Australia.

draft_ops_note: Reads only. Each cron writes to its own store, never to the business's books.

xero.covers: budget read and budget summary read (read only)

gaps: Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Fathom Finance: its docs describe budgets, KPIs and reports, but the kit has no ops file for it, so no adapter is built.
Microsoft 365: the docs set covers accessibility articles only, with no budgeting, so no adapter is built.
Burn rate and variance: the budget summary rows are not parsed yet. The cron stores the raw report and the agent reads it. The row shape needs checking against a live Xero demo company.
Overspend alerts, budget editing, forecasting, approval checks at spend and a budget decision log: not in the Xero API map, or not described in the docs. A live Xero account is needed to confirm.
Owner or accountant hand-off: any email would go through a mailbox, which is not mapped for this job. No live operation is mapped, so nothing is queued.
The test covers the read-only guard. There is no live operation, so the approve-and-run path is not exercised.
